verdict.rationale:
Docs confirm self-hosters can bring their own API keys via custom endpoints supporting OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible providers (librechat-docs-21, librechat-docs-4), which covers the BYOK half of the story. However, there is no evidence in the pack of any token usage tracking, cost calculation, or per-model/per-conversation usage reporting feature.

missing for 10: evidence of token usage metering, cost-per-model or cost-per-conversation reporting, admin/usage dashboards.
